reader.requirement: At --std 85, a SAME RECORD AREA, SAME SORT AREA or SAME SORT-MERGE AREA clause (the Sort-Merge format, naming a sort or merge file) must be refused when any of its file-names, in the file-name-1 or any file-name-2 position, references an external file connector (an FD with IS EXTERNAL); internal files, including a GLOBAL one where no other rule bars it, are not affected by this rule.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Year < 2002 changes only the REPORT-file occurrence limits of the SAME clause (§1985:XIII.2.4.3 SR2); not the external-connector test

reader.edition-search: Read ScreenSameOperands: the `file.IsExternal` refusal has no edition test and runs for all three SAME formats (RecordArea, SortMergeArea, Area); grep of VersionConformancePass.cs for SAME clause gates found none for this operand rule.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (same obligation as §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR3; the diagnostic cites the 2023 rule at --std 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers one SAME clause with an external file; the three spellings RECORD/SORT/SORT-MERGE, the file-name-1 position, a three-operand clause and the internal positive control are not all in it (probed here)

reader.notes: One edition-blind test per operand refuses an external file connector in every SAME format and operand position. An internal file in a sort-area clause is accepted and sorts. Diagnostic face: COBOL2738 cites ISO §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR3 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XI.2.5 whole (format SAME {RECORD|SORT|SORT-MERGE} AREA; SR1-6) and its I-O sibling §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR2, which states the same bar for SAME [RECORD] AREA, so the edition-blind FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs#ScreenSameOperands refusing every SAME form over-reaches nothing at 85. Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-07/c6), aimed past the reader's: recsh.cob SAME RECORD AREA FOR S H with S a sort file and H EXTERNAL (the Sort-Merge format's RECORD arm, file-name-2 position) -> COBOL2738; recint.cob the same with H internal -> sorts, 'F1 AAAA'; twocl.cob two SAME clauses (RECORD and SORT) in one I-O-CONTROL both naming external H -> COBOL2738 once per clause; plain.cob SAME AREA FOR G H (the VII format) with external H -> COBOL2738, which §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR2 also requires; sdext.cob SD S IS EXTERNAL -> COBOL1970 (an SD has no EXTERNAL clause, so a sort file can never be an external connector). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR2  (2.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'; 'OK  §1985:VII.2.13.3 SR2  (2.13.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'.
